Fresh food can be replaced or refunded when it is damaged, incorrect, or unsafe. The customer should contact Sunrise Bakery within 24 hours of pickup or delivery and provide the order number and a photo when possible. We do not refund fresh food only because a customer changed their mind or disliked a flavor that was correctly prepared.

Question: Can I get a refund just because I changed my mind about a correctly prepared flavor?
No. Sunrise Bakery does not refund correctly prepared fresh food only because a customer changed their mind or disliked the flavor.

Custom-cake deposits are refundable until seven calendar days before the pickup date. After that deadline, the deposit is not refundable because ingredients and decoration work have been scheduled. If Sunrise Bakery cancels an order, the customer receives a full refund, including the deposit.

Question: When can I get a custom-cake deposit back?
You can get the deposit back until seven calendar days before pickup. It is also fully refunded if Sunrise Bakery cancels the order.
